- b) Reference cue: the bowl spans roughly 2 dark beans or onion rings laid across... more practically, the bowl is about 10 bean-lengths across (beans about 2.2 cm), giving about 22-24 cm.

- Cooked dark beans: about 127 kcal/100 g.
